name: dev.voar/voar
title: voar
description: Read your organization's GitHub Actions jobs and usage on voar. Read-only.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read the bound organization's plan, credit balance, free units per month and how many are used, concurrency limit, live runners, and queued jobs.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List recent GitHub Actions jobs for the bound organization, newest first, with runner size, status, conclusion, billed units, cost in micros, and any problem that blocked a launch.

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return, from 1 to 100.

before.description: Return only jobs queued before this ISO 8601 timestamp, for keyset pagination.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Read the bound organization's finished jobs, billed units, and paid cost in micros for a billing month (America/Sao_Paulo), broken down by day. Costs are in the currency that get_account returns.

month.description: Billing month as YYYY-MM in America/Sao_Paulo. Defaults to the current month.
